cross_references.verdict: NOT densely interlinked. Three explicit cross-references exist in 641 lines, and two of the three are intra-section, leaving exactly ONE genuine cross-section link in the entire document (line 146 -> line 115/124). The only genuinely cross-cutting vocabulary is model_version (8 sections) and the SAST/make-validate family (4 sections, and that is duplication, not dependency). Critically, every large deletable region has ZERO inbound references from anywhere else: Canva/diagrams (475-503), Watch Filters (150-177), Terraform Cloud (59-71), the SQL subsection (33-43), Interfaces (372-385). This document can be split or pruned cleanly, section by section. Only two things need deliberate handling rather than mechanical deletion: (a) the three technology-neutral bullets buried inside the SQL block, lines 36, 39 and 41 (see lb-002, lb-003), and (b) the model_version contract, which must be relocated to a shared place before any split.

load_bearing.caveat: Two things the retirement decision will otherwise miss. First, the mandate is only half-true today: the make-sast invocation is `|| true`, so Bandit already fails to gate there (see aud-008).
